name: SimpleLogin
description: SimpleLogin is an open-source email alias solution that lets you create anonymous email aliases to protect your real email address from spam, trackers and data breaches.

notes.text: Set EMAIL_DOMAIN and URL in /opt/simplelogin/.env and add MX, SPF, DKIM and PTR records for your domain. The DKIM record is in /opt/simplelogin/dkim/dkim.dns.txt (replace EMAIL_DOMAIN in it).
Mail delivery must work, or the activation email after registration never arrives. Set myhostname, mydomain and mynetworks in /etc/postfix/main.cf, then restart postfix.
There is no default login: register the first admin account in the web interface.
